claims.summary: Current browser auth uses token login and a signed HttpOnly cookie.
Production browser auth validates Access JWT signature and claims, derives verified-email principals and keeps Bearer automation separate.
Sessions, mutable Agent runtime state, Memory, vectors and persistent Desktop approvals are principal-scoped; owner retains the legacy data paths.
Ask performs no Memory or tool writes and all vector retrieval paths soft-degrade without hidden runtime initialization.
Plan may inspect through ToolGateway; write and exec capabilities are rejected.
Current Auto v1 uses AgentToolLoop, ToolGateway and verifier.

Auto supplies an independent positive native-call cap to the existing ToolLoop/Gateway path. Each completed ToolResult, including failure or denial, consumes one call; ApprovalRequired does not. Captured continuation retains cap and executed prefix across resume; N+1 is blocked before Gateway/approval, while exactly N is not automatically budget failure. Iteration safety guard and verifier remain separate; uncapped callers retain prior semantics. Dispatch faults stop without replay and preserve available typed prefix, without asserting the unknown last effect. This is not strict wall-time, file/token accounting, durable recovery or new authority.

Auto fences new model generation, post-model acceptance, each native/approved call and verifier admission at the original finite monotonic expiry, including approval wait and exact >= boundary. Captured continuation retains expiry across new loop/env settings; cancellation precedes expiry at loop and pre-verifier boundaries, completed prefix survives budget stop. Already-running operations are not interrupted and a verifier admitted before expiry can finish later. Expiry-less callers, R1a quota and existing authorization remain; no hard deadline, file/token/retry accounting, persistence or durable recovery claim.

Existing sync adapters and shared SSE decoder use one pure usage validator: all three explicit nonnegative integer (non-bool) counts produce LLMUsage, including explicit zero; missing, partial or invalid metadata becomes unknown None without discarding valid text/tool calls. Existing xAI input/output aliases and canonical precedence remain. Unknown emits no synthetic zero Usage event; complete updates remain separate. No inferred total, aggregation, quota, transport, capability, authority or billing verification change.

Sync Auto opts into immutable external Brain.generate usage accounting: started/reported/unknown calls and complete reported sums survive approval continuation and available stop/fault results. Synthetic resume is not another model request; received metadata precedes post-model cancellation/expiry. Numeric Auto-state projection rejects malformed summaries without synthesizing usage. Accounting alone does not stop execution; Auto token admission is a separate policy. Internal HTTP retries, other model consumers, stream aggregation, verifier usage, billing, quota and durable recovery are not covered; existing dispatch/approval/expiry/cap behavior remains.

Sync Auto gates only the next genuine Brain.generate on captured reported token limit: first request allowed, unknown usage blocks with an uncertainty reason, complete sum >= cap blocks as exhausted. Captured cap and accounting survive approvals/new loop/env; synthetic approved remainder and final verifier retain existing guards. Cancellation/expiry precede token admission; no automatic replay. Existing defaults/loader, non-Auto and streaming policy remain. This is not a hard spending/billing cap: active request overshoot, HTTP retries, other model consumers and verifier usage are not covered.
Deterministic Ask to Plan to Act orchestration is a target, not current Auto behavior.
Target architecture derives typed user-facing communication artifacts from authoritative lifecycle state through a communication decision layer; current streaming/UIHub paths are not this contract.

Target architecture accepts lifecycle completion only after policy-selected verification and acceptance for the exact task/result/artifact revision; current verifier paths are partial evidence mechanisms.

Target lifecycle contract separates terminal cause (completed/failed/cancelled/aborted) from result disposition (full/accepted_partial/none), treats supersession as status/lineage, and gives every accepted Ask a durable task identity with one semantic final; current runtime is not this contract.

Owner can save an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, then select a session model. Custom routes start Chat-only and members remain denied. Explicit owner/session confirm checks four inert sync/stream tool-call and role=tool requests without host actions or chat history. Transient Agent-owned evidence binds exact endpoint/model/effective headers/key and config/credential revisions; changed/revoked context and other sessions remain unqualified. No proof is persisted in ModelConfig. Existing ToolGateway policy remains mandatory. LocalHttpBrain native SSE is scoped/cancellable with no redirects/replay. Built-in legacy adapter admission is not model qualification; no production endpoint is claimed qualified by fixture tests.

Target SlavikAI provides a first-class user-selected subscription-backed OpenAI/ChatGPT access route distinct from API-key billing, with explicit entitlement, trust and non-silent fallback boundaries; no current runtime implementation is claimed.

Explicit Memory requests create a preview; only confirm or edit-and-confirm writes it, while reject performs no write. End-session first asks Yes/No/Cancel and prepares a summary only after Yes; a separate Memory confirmation is required before saving and closing.
The public API exposes and accepts only the exact proxy model id slavik; all other IDs are rejected before Agent resolution.
Desktop uses owner-scoped persistent approvals, one shared-host run lease, dispatch allowlisting and observable retryable rollback.
Manifest body instructions and supporting dependencies are resolved and injected per run into Auto v1; MWV reporting observes the run without changing tool or verification authority.
A clean local PR branch can run preflight before it has an upstream.
The environment example uses a complete OpenAI-compatible chat completions URL.
Production background execution has separate venv-prod pid and log targets.
Sandbox process execution is unavailable under I0 before spawn. Existing process-result projection semantics remain defined, but no qualified generic Sandbox executor is shipped.
Complete scoped durable execution evidence precedes lossy projections; configurable seven-day terminal retention excludes active, resumable and recovery-pinned data.

Scoped durable admission identities, immutable revision/history and CAS transitions. UI Ask and Auto now admit and fence repeated dispatch after volatile replay loss using structured request fingerprints bound to grants, effective tools/policy and full execution config, with pre-admission history checked before dispatch. Existing admitted runs cannot be reclaimed without durable execution context. The native UI persists a pending client key/hash across lost acknowledgement and reload, requires explicit discard before replacing an uncertain payload and allows discard without dispatch, and targets regeneration deletion by immutable message identity; tests inject isolated app stores. Native UI Ask/Auto approval checkpoints now retain the admitted run identity; resume validates its exact scoped state/version and owned effective-security fingerprint before grants/dispatch, then submits the typed result to the same run. Root confirmation rejects changed mode/model snapshots. Public /v1 default/explicit Ask and explicit Auto now share scoped admission/CAS/submission with complete request/config/security fingerprints; no runtime_mode request inherits the previous Agent mode, and retries cannot redispatch. Other production entrypoints, durable continuation, result capture, acceptance/completion and recovery remain target.

Existing admitted UI/API Ask/Auto and captured approval continuation atomically bind an immutable scoped producer-report envelope to result_submitted history in the existing TaskRunStore. Exact v2-to-v3 additive upgrade preserves old identities/history with historical payload unavailable. CAS, rollback, scoped read, digest, size limits and HTTP projection/storage faults are tested. Producer text is not canonical tool capture, terminal acceptance or replay/recovery authority; sensitive nonterminal payload may remain indefinitely without GC.

Native Ask/Desktop/Auto approval continues the captured exact tool call and original history without user replay. Desktop retains a bounded host lease and thread-affine resources until resume or cleanup. Single-use state is principal/session-owned and volatile; missing/expired checkpoints fail closed. Local web search uses this same native loop; admission snapshots, HTTP cancellation settlement, original Ask finalization, compound once-scopes and UI history projection are covered. Auto preserves its original run frame, plan, start time and budgets; legacy auto.run replay is rejected. Act packet runner now owns a volatile exact-request checkpoint preserving original packet, prefix, available typed tool observations and attempt; UI snapshots cannot claim completed execution. Once approval uses Gateway exact scope, pre-dispatch faults preserve pending state, and HTTP session grants roll back if resume did not start. Durable continuation, full canonical capture and payload storage remain target. Plan cancel clears the owned checkpoint and decision under the scoped lock; terminal projection faults retain the last typed MWV result and settle the consumed decision. Initial pre-dispatch model conflict ends the owned task without dispatch. Retry checkpoints validate original lineage while executing their owned retry revision; fault settlement records the active attempt/task. Approval publication uses one UI storage write with rollback/cleanup on failure. Reject cleanup borrows the existing owner; scoped matching initial/resume cancellation signals before lock and preserves terminal results. Reject atomically commits terminal workflow and decision before checkpoint cleanup; storage failure preserves waiting state. Cancellation before first dispatch projects cancelled; shutdown timeout is diagnostic and does not interrupt remaining cleanup. Waiting-plan cancellation atomically commits workflow/decision removal before checkpoint cleanup. Cancelled workers preserve completed step results, available changes and counters. Scoped/static Agent retirement retains borrowers and locks after timeout; packet-thread cancellation drains before releasing ownership. Pending opaque tools do not acquire a durability/recovery guarantee.

Request-local typed Agent response reaches HTTP through sync return or ResponseProduced stream event. Auto outcome and returned Ask LLMResult/AgentToolLoopResult remain separate from text projection; post-result review/logging errors retain observations, explicit stream error/cancellation retains returned loop result, cancellation during dispatch captures completed ToolResult before stopping further calls and HTTP drains the typed observation without publishing cancelled content, provider creation/iteration exceptions retain completed observations through ToolLoopExecutionError, and ApprovalRequired reaches the existing outer approval handler. Missing/duplicate stream results fail without stale mutable result reads or execution rerun. Volatile boundary only: lifecycle authority, exceptional dispatch/serialization capture and canonical durability remain target. Returned MWVRunResult reaches sync/stream HTTP boundary with original work/verifier statuses and bounded retry metadata; formatting/decision/logging faults retain it separately from ResponseFailure. Act packet runner retains available typed tool observations before diff projection and on cancellation; its approval checkpoint is volatile. MWV full raw byte capture, durable continuation and full prior attempt history remain target. Desktop initial/resume responses retain the existing DesktopRunOutcome including verification and loop observations; presentation faults preserve it separately. No durable/canonical capture guarantee added.

Browser personal preferences are principal-scoped with subject-bound CAS, independent installation permissions, defaults for new principals and no import of global personal values; new browser model requests consume tone/instructions as user input without modifying system prompts or policy; tool continuations retain their original messages and Bearer requests use defaults.

Implicit UI configuration shapes consistently select local embeddings. Runtime model loads are cache-only, absent dependencies degrade Chat without remote fallback, local load can recover after files appear, explicit remote selection is preserved and existing vectors are not rebuilt.

A nonblocking browser notice explains unavailable local semantic search. Verified owner eligibility exposes explicit confirmed download, cached activation or retry through the existing endpoint. File presence and loaded weights are distinct; GET never initializes the runtime. Absent libraries get manual server guidance without fake installer or agent repair. Unknown diagnostics fail closed, Chat remains usable, and refreshed or unmounted observers ignore stale responses.

Owned session model changes reject active Chat/Plan and pending decisions until cancellation settles. Scoped execution locks cover model-bound decision creation, plan publication and project history/result publication. Approval steps enter waiting before decision visibility. Model revisions fence stale catalog and request snapshots; hydration cannot overwrite newer selection. UI manual and automatic restoration share generation/token ownership, preserving the current model request when New Chat fails.

Plan approve and execute require the displayed plan identity, hash and revision. UIHub atomically approves only the captured draft in Plan mode, rolls back storage failure and publishes after commit. Fresh execution validates the full binding; accepted idempotent replay retains its original binding during running revisions. Structured execution decisions capture and revalidate the full binding before execution or edits, rejecting replaced plans even at the same revision. Typed browser helpers take an explicit PlanEnvelope. Plan-card UI readiness is not claimed.

Canonical revisions fence late vector publication. Bound principal stores atomically delete exact canonical/atoms vector rows with bounded idempotency receipts on supported rollback-journal file DBs. Deprecated pins are excluded. Storage boundary only; browser API is tracked separately by memory.browser_management_api. No new model capability; Settings UI tracked separately. Encoding errors preserve prior vector and explicit partial-index save semantics.

Verified browser principal gets model/session-independent canonical pagination and exact-revision delete preview/explicit confirmation through an existing confirmed-only, non-model-exposed gateway tool. Bounded persisted opaque bindings survive restart; foreign/stale/expired/rebound operations fail closed, private responses are no-store and logs contain no Memory plaintext. Additive preferences_subject binds responses to the Settings account without changing Memory cursor subjects. UI tracked separately; auth tests use post-verifier identity fixtures, not deployed Access proof.

Settings reads paged owned canonical Memory independently of models/chats and previews one exact-revision deletion before explicit confirmation through the existing API. Account/operation/epoch fences reject mismatched and late responses; reopened panels wait for known confirmations before listing. No bulk wipe or false erasure claim. UI fixtures and temporary-store HTTP evidence do not establish deployed Access/provider behavior.

Owner Settings projects twelve configured ContextBudgetConfig values through a narrow separate read-only GET field and Advanced table. Member has no projection; writes to diagnostics or nested context_budget are rejected before settings mutation. No duplicated React defaults, per-field provenance, running Agent effective snapshot, token window or Auto enforcement claim. Existing inbox/embeddings Memory saves preserve the loaded ContextBudgetConfig; custom values survive fresh file reload and read view without enabling budget writes or member authority. No runtime consumer or concurrency guarantee change.

Verified auth metadata binds immutable browser subject context before bootstrap. Reachable last session/model/explorer/recent-root hints use explicit captured subjects; legacy values are not read/migrated and unavailable storage or subject disables persistence. Identity refresh is epoch fenced; subject changes remount private App, same-subject/transient failures preserve drafts, explicit denial removes App. No server auth authority change, instantaneous identity fencing or pending-send protocol claim; local/token tests do not re-enable legacy production auth.

Owner Settings exposes a separate read-only saved default model projection from the existing loader. Finite safe numerics, known enums, bools and null are sanitized; sensitive overrides expose presence only. Members omit diagnostics and POST is rejected. No React defaults, model probes, editor, active-chat capability or credential precedence claim. The separately adopted strict-bool loader prerequisite restores web_search_enabled; this read-only view reports the loaded request, not executed search or active-chat options.

Browser validates the existing owned session security snapshot before showing known policy/safe-mode or editable controls. Malformed, foreign, missing and failed reads remain unavailable. Epoch and conversation guards reject late read/save completions; reopening waits for known pending writes then reads, with no automatic POST retry. Save settlement separately refreshes the still-selected saved session summary even after the panel closes; other sessions are ignored. Existing explicit save and YOLO confirmations are preserved. No server authorization, grant provenance/revision/revoke, Desktop approval or instant identity fencing claim.

Owner Settings reads a narrow principal-bound saved Desktop rule projection through the existing shared store. Inspection never rewrites the rule file; existing runtime/list/mutation behavior is preserved. Sensitive command/description/ID/email/error contents are omitted; only known typed file-target tool/action roles expose paths, including separate download destinations. XPath/GUI/unknown targets and command/risk restrictions remain explicitly hidden. Captured-subject/epoch guards reject foreign and late responses; read failure is not an empty list, UI has no mutators. No new grant authority, revoke, effective-action permission, transient approval or host lease claim.

Owned session security GET captures saved policy and tool overrides under one existing UIHub lock, then projects known tool configuration sources from the same override map as displayed values. No session/grant writes or runtime consumer changes. Source labels describe configuration at refresh, including equal-value overrides and loader defaults; missing/invalid metadata and unsaved tool drafts remain unavailable. Existing session/epoch/save fencing preserved. No per-file default provenance, active-run capability, unified grant revision or revoke claim.

Existing owned session security POST validates all policy/tools input under the existing scoped agent lock before invoking either existing setter. Invalid combined requests cannot persist an earlier valid policy section. Owner/member ownership, YOLO confirmation, root constraints and valid update semantics remain unchanged. No new permission authority, API/schema, runtime consumers, CAS/revision or storage-failure transaction guarantee.

Saved session policy/raw tool overrides have a persisted revision and owned UIHub CAS. Trusted setters/import publish candidates after persistence; SQLite rejects stale snapshots inside the write transaction. Metadata initialization preserves configuration/messages. This is a storage prerequisite only: HTTP/UI preconditions remain unimplemented; installation defaults, grants, live revoke and multi-worker runtime are excluded. Existing startup-only principal normalization is revision-checked; NULL/blank principals restore to the configured owner, named principals cannot be reassigned and ordinary writers keep strict ownership checks.

Owned session security GET/POST expose saved-config revision and ETag from one captured snapshot. POST requires exact If-Match (428 missing, 400 malformed, 409 conflict), validates the full payload and existing root/YOLO guards under the scoped execution lock, then performs one persisted UIHub CAS. UI captures the selected-session revision; conflict requires a fresh read and another explicit save, with no automatic retry. Installation defaults, grants and running policy snapshots remain separate.

ModelConfig load preserves only JSON bool web_search_enabled; absent stays False and malformed non-bools raise without value echo. File reload/cold hydration and inert existing xAI request-path tests preserve session override precedence and distinguish saved configuration from active runtime. No new search executor, provider qualification, tools, grants, prompt strings, editor or live activation.

Owner-only no-store Settings snapshot projects existing server attachment validator constants; Developer displays items and Unicode code points per item/total without numeric React defaults. Member omits diagnostics, POST rejects before writes, malformed/missing metadata stays unavailable. No caps, parser, send, upload, model/provider capability or permission changes.

Owner-only no-store Settings projects existing short-term and summary input constants. Memory Advanced distinguishes transient user/assistant entries from saved-history summary messages and Unicode content slices, not retention, token window or remaining capacity. Member omits snapshot, POST rejects, missing/malformed values unavailable without React defaults. No Agent creation, summary generation, prompts, limits or Memory confirmation/lifecycle changes.

Owner-only no-store Settings snapshot allowlists numeric WebSearchConfig class defaults. Developer distinguishes candidate count, per-attempt timeout and content read budget from active tool/model state, result guarantees, total deadline and strict output size. Member omits snapshot, POST rejects, malformed values unavailable without React defaults. No tools/HTTP clients constructed, keys or provider exposed, capability probes, runtime/send/config/permission changes.

Owner-only no-store snapshot allowlists four numeric TtsConfig/SttConfig class defaults. Developer distinguishes Unicode text slices/per-attempt timeout and Agent STT from separate browser dictation. Member omits snapshot, POST rejects, malformed metadata unavailable without React defaults. New snapshot resolves no options/keys, constructs no tools/HTTP clients and runs no speech/capability request; existing env diagnostics, runtime, auth/approval and credentials unchanged.

Owner-only no-store snapshot allowlists two pure ShellConfig numeric defaults without loading policy, normalization, tools or subprocess. Developer distinguishes per-operation JSON overrides, subprocess timeout and post-capture Unicode truncation (combined ShellTool versus per-stream TerminalTool oneshot, markers extra) from PTY/Desktop, task deadlines, memory/output caps or effective grants/root/allowlist. Member omits metadata, POST rejects, malformed values unavailable without React defaults. Runtime and permission enforcement unchanged. I0 blocks Sandbox process execution before these configured limits are used; the read-only defaults snapshot is not execution readiness.

Owned no-store read projects numeric/enum/bool/null model options only from an existing paused approval continuation bound to current pending decision, session, identity and execution mode. GET creates no session/Agent/brain and resolves no model; no sensitive contents or fallback to defaults/main_config. Session Controls explicit read discards stale panel/session responses without writes. This is captured paused configuration, not general running state, permission, provider acceptance or resumability; capture/resume/cancel and persisted schemas unchanged.

After an attempted installation POST, HTTP/transport/unreadable-response failure discloses possible partial persistence and asks the user to check saved values before an explicit retry. Drafts survive, no automatic POST or false success callback; local validation and personal-only conflicts keep separate semantics. A readable Settings acknowledgement is required for installation confirmation and malformed bodies are not echoed. Existing server write order, role/policy, model/provider activation and transaction guarantees unchanged; exact applied fields remain unknown.

Default Sandbox tools, process verifier, manual terminal/Git/import and unqualified container commands refuse before host spawn/input. Explicit qualified rootless native workspace_run is the sole exception described in the same contract; it cannot fall back to Host. Required process verification stays unavailable/error; process-free checks and explicit Desktop authority retain their boundaries.

Explicit pinned rootless Podman profile admits only native workspace_run through scoped Gateway and ComputerBackend. Principal-owned managed workspaces coordinate six writers, once approval binds immutable workspace/environment revision, finite explicit kernel tmpfs byte/inode slots bound active and retained private nofollow stages (one per principal), container logs are disabled, unknown mount ownership denies reuse, and bounded transfer plus atomic publication requires original content/revision after container settlement. Unknown/conflict stops subsequent tool/model calls without publication/replay. Raw bytes and actual exit exist internally; durable capture, run-intent fencing/recovery, other process consumers and production activation remain outside this partial slice. Unit tests do not independently prove OS isolation; real synthetic qualification evidence is recorded separately.

Only admitted synchronous Auto UI/API workspace_run and its captured native approval carry the original scoped run binding to the qualified rootless byte boundary. Existing guards precede durable operation intent, which is required before container start. Raw separate prefixes (1MiB/stream), observed counts/EOF, actual child exit or unknown, timeout/capture errors and digests commit atomically before opaque refs and bounded 32KiB UTF-8 views. Capture/store faults stop subsequent dispatch without replay; late historical observations cannot resurrect aborted runs. Additive Store v3-to-v4 preserves prior producer reports and history; sensitive raw bytes may remain indefinitely without aggregate DB quota or GC. Other tools/entrypoints, full canonical capture, acceptance and recovery remain target. Pytest stubs OS/engine boundaries; actual qualified synthetic evidence is separate.
